AI-01.text: malformed/duplicate/out-of-range output receives one bounded repair then fails safely; editor remains usable.

DEP-01.text: clean checkout install, typecheck, lint, unit test and production build are deterministic.

DEP-02.text: public/fork CI cannot access production secrets and still runs all synthetic checks.

DEP-03.text: preview cannot access production data/credentials; exact deployed SHA and environment are known.

DEP-04.text: owner works; anonymous/non-owner UI/API/server actions fail; logout and token refresh/revocation behave safely.

DEP-05.text: required T0/T1/T2 and authorised T3 are green; T4 passes on the exact HTTPS candidate.

DEP-06.text: security headers, no-store, TLS, callback allowlist, timezone and provider capabilities are verified, not inferred.

DEP-07.text: rollback/runbook restores the prior app deployment while preserving Sheet/Drive/Typefully content and unrelated infrastructure.

DRV-01.text: exact Unicode/line breaks round-trip in the intended Library-ID section; adjacent sections are byte-equivalent.

DRV-02.text: missing/duplicate Library ID, moved file, stale revision and permission failure make no unsafe write.

DRV-03.text: Sheet-success/Drive-failure and Drive-success/Sheet-failure expose PARTIAL_FAILURE with deterministic retry/reconcile; no false success.

DRV-04.text: each partial-failure permutation has an idempotent recovery path and truthful status.

ENQA-01.text: known British/American spelling, punctuation, banned-word and platform fixtures produce structured, attributable findings.

ENQA-02.text: accepting one finding changes only the selected range; reject/cancel leaves exact draft untouched.

ENQA-03.text: late results against a changed draft are stale and cannot apply.

HOOK-01.text: normal success has exactly three materially distinct alternatives with valid canonical framework names and scores equal to their five dimensions.

HOOK-02.text: original remains selectable and unchanged until confirmation; generation alone writes nothing.

HOOK-03.text: selection updates hook and opening together or not at all from the user's perspective; partial external failure is explicit/recoverable.

HOOK-04.text: LinkedIn alternatives show all LinkedInify checks; X Premium is not incorrectly capped at 280 characters.

HOOK-05.text: stale generation/selection cannot overwrite a newer draft or existing chosen hook.

MAP-01.text: every current Content Library/Ready Queue/Content Schedule header maps once or is explicitly pass-through.

MAP-02.text: missing/duplicate required fields fail safely; unknown extra columns survive round trips.

MAP-03.text: all 33 Library and 44 Schedule headers match the committed mapping.

MAP-04.text: reordered columns and new unknown columns work; renamed/missing required columns produce SCHEMA_DRIFT with no write.

MIG-01.text: approved decision record shows measured trigger, alternatives, cost/risk and rollback.

MIG-02.text: snapshot/replay preserves exact content and stable IDs with reconciled counts/hashes.

MIG-03.text: shadow-read parity covers every mapped field/state and declares exceptions; UI behaviour is adapter-identical.

MIG-04.text: anonymous/non-owner/direct API/RPC access is denied; secrets remain server-only.

MIG-05.text: cutover and rollback are rehearsed on synthetic/copy data; no period has two uncoordinated authorities.

OBS-01.text: health output contains commit/capability status, never content, tokens, account IDs or Drive names.

OBS-02.text: adapter latency, quota/rate-limit and write result are observable with redaction.

OBS-03.text: duration, token use, provider/model/prompt version and redacted error code are recorded.

OBS-04.text: provider status, duration, rate limit and redacted reconciliation outcome are recorded without copy.

OBS-05.text: every typed error has a user message, recovery action and redacted structured event.

OBS-06.text: logs/traces/errors contain no post text, Markdown body, private Drive path/URL, token or owner identifier; synthetic sentinel test proves redaction.

OBS-07.text: retry uses the original operation ID/expected target and cannot duplicate a Sheet/Drive/Typefully mutation.

OBS-08.text: schema drift, repeated auth refresh failure, provider write failure and stale published sync meet documented alert thresholds.

PUB-01.text: published detail matches exact Schedule/Typefully values and retains X/Threads lineage without combining metrics.

PUB-02.text: unavailable metric stays blank; zero remains zero; stale/partial coverage is visible.

PUB-03.text: repeated analytics sync is idempotent and cannot overwrite newer manual/provider final copy.

PUB-04.text: published URL/time/status conflicts require reconciliation rather than inferred correction.

PUB-05.text: aggregates state platform, date range, included rows and last sync; rows with missing data are not silently treated as zero.

QA-01.text: every required acceptance ID has a pass or explicit scoped blocker/owner; none are silently missing.

QA-02.text: data-loss, duplicate-publish, auth/privacy and stale-overwrite tests pass before release.

QA-03.text: accessibility/visual checks pass on supported browsers; emulation is not claimed as physical-device proof.

QA-04.text: private-data scans cover repo, history, CI logs/artifacts and screenshots.

QA-05.text: defects gain regression tests and are retested on the exact candidate environment.

READY-01.text: table-driven tests cover every hard gate and explain the exact blocker/next action.

READY-02.text: Ready Queue is read/derived only and matches approved queued Library rows.

READY-03.text: only Approved + queued items with every applicable hard gate pass show Ready.

READY-04.text: LinkedIn correctly skips translation; X requiring Threads adaptation and stale zh-TW states are handled explicitly.

READY-05.text: image-required/unapproved, stale visual and screenshot reuse cases block; Text only passes when explicitly decided.

READY-06.text: changing any source after load re-evaluates gates and prevents stale promotion.

READY-07.text: no API/UI route can create a Schedule record from an unapproved/non-Library item.

REV-01.text: illegal stage transitions and stale approvals are rejected server-side, not only disabled in UI.

REV-02.text: concurrent row change produces STALE_READ/CONFLICT and preserves both versions.

REV-03.text: filters compose, persist safely in URL enums/IDs and return the same results as bounded repository queries.

REV-04.text: REWORK and CHECK cannot be approved/queued until resolved; the exact blocker is shown.

REV-05.text: empty queue, no filter matches and provider failure are distinct; existing results are not falsely replaced by empty.

REV-06.text: approve/skip/request-change updates only intended Sheet fields and handles stale rows without overwrite.

REV-07.text: exact emoji/CJK/whitespace/line breaks round-trip; no trim or silent rewrite.

REV-08.text: two-tab and external Sheet/Drive edits create a resolvable conflict, not last-write-wins.

REV-09.text: resolving one reconciliation item re-reads all authorities and closes it only when agreement/gates are proven.

SCHED-01.text: correct platform/slot/timezone options come from Workflow Settings; missing/TBD policy blocks automatic scheduling.

SCHED-02.text: preview shows every value to be written and no unrelated column; source link/Library lineage remains traceable.

SCHED-03.text: stale gate, occupied slot, duplicate Content ID, two-tab promotion or external row change conflicts safely.

SCHED-04.text: Threads row links the approved X parent and cannot precede required adaptation/QA.

SCHED-05.text: direct API attempts cannot bypass Ready gates; new content cannot jump into Schedule.

SEC-01.text: tracked files/history and CI artifacts reject a synthetic leak sentinel; no actual private values exist.

SEC-02.text: untrusted Sheet/Markdown/provider values cannot select code paths outside validated enums/contracts.

SEC-03.text: range bounds, IDs and values are validated; logs contain hashes/IDs only, no post copy.

SEC-04.text: executable/injection content and unexpected external links remain inert data.

SEC-05.text: anonymous and authenticated non-owner calls fail for pages, APIs and server actions without disclosing resource existence.

SEC-06.text: forged role/target IDs, cross-origin mutation and expired/revoked sessions fail safely.

SEC-07.text: no provider token appears in browser bundles, cookies readable by JS, URLs, logs or errors.

SEC-08.text: read-only mode works when write scopes/provider credentials are absent; mutation controls and APIs deny consistently.

SEC-09.text: logout clears session and tab-local private recovery; private responses are no-store.

SEC-10.text: URLs/telemetry contain IDs and filter enums only, never post text or private Drive paths.

SEC-11.text: tab recovery is owner/session namespaced, bounded and cleared on logout; no tokens/source archives stored.

SEC-12.text: prompt injection cannot request tools, secrets, external fetches or authority changes; logs contain no copy/provider payload.

TYPE-01.text: existing ID, one match, ambiguous matches, no match and provider failure are distinct states.

TYPE-02.text: double click, timeout-after-create and retry produce at most one provider draft and one linked Sheet record.

TYPE-03.text: ambiguous similarity never auto-links/creates; user sees the discriminating date/slot/platform preview.

TYPE-04.text: exact Unicode/whitespace from Typefully lands in Final Content; working Content is unchanged.

TYPE-05.text: concurrent Typefully/Sheet edits produce comparison/conflict and cannot silently overwrite newer work.

THEME-01.text: black, white and neutral surfaces dominate; the former blue primary treatment is removed.

THEME-02.text: green means confirmed, yellow means attention and red means blocked/error, always with a visible label and glyph or shape.

THEME-03.text: Backlog and Calendar share one deterministic PESTO/content-pillar palette; unknown and empty values remain neutral.

THEME-04.text: the themed interface passes unit, browser, accessibility and desktop/phone visual verification.

UX-01.text: all routes/navigation work with keyboard, visible focus, landmarks and meaningful labels.

UX-02.text: loading, empty, no-match, not-configured, blocked, conflict, rate-limited and provider-error states are visually/semantically distinct.

UX-03.text: no page overflow at target widths/zoom; long URLs, English and CJK wrap without hiding controls.

UX-04.text: navigation/filter changes never discard a dirty editor without explicit choice.

UX-05.text: keyboard, 200% zoom and CJK/long-copy cards pass; next action is not color-only.

UX-06.text: navigation, refresh, session expiry and delayed proposals never discard/replace a dirty draft.

UX-07.text: calendar/list is keyboard and zoom accessible with status conveyed beyond colour.

VIS-01.text: image previews enforce supported MIME/size and never expose credentials/private stable download URLs.

VIS-02.text: incomplete brief or >4 main ideas cannot enter approved rendering flow; Text only remains a valid complete decision.

VIS-03.text: deterministic fixture renders preserve locked colors/composition rules and readable 360/390 previews.

VIS-04.text: approval belongs to exact file/version/platform/language; replacement or source-copy change invalidates it.

VIS-05.text: reused screenshot on same platform blocks; reuse on another platform and fresh original graphics follow defined rules.

VIS-06.text: alt text, caveat and illustrative reconstruction labels are required/accurate where applicable.

ZHTW-01.text: non-approved/stale X sources cannot generate an approvable Threads version.

ZHTW-02.text: generated copy is Traditional Chinese, uses Taiwan terminology fixtures and preserves meaning without literal calques.

ZHTW-03.text: Parent Content ID/date/slot linkage is deterministic; ambiguous/multiple candidates require review.

ZHTW-04.text: X edit after translation visibly invalidates ZH approval and linked visual revision; late results are discarded.

ZHTW-05.text: Chinese QA approval is explicit; failure leaves manual editing/copy recovery usable.
